label: RPC node (unpriced)
description: Editable cost assumptions. No provider, machine size or deployment region has been selected.
priceNote: No rates supplied. Hosted nodes (Alchemy, Infura, QuickNode) price by plan, often in “compute units” that differ per method, and none publishes a machine-readable price list. Enter your plan’s cost per million requests. A node you run yourself is a server.

requests.note: Your plan’s cost per million requests; hosted nodes price by plan, often in compute units.

label: Smart contract (unpriced)
description: Editable cost assumptions. No provider, machine size or deployment region has been selected.
priceNote: No rates supplied. Gas is paid in the chain’s own token, at a base fee that changes every block, so no list can say what it costs today. Enter your cost in USD per million gas at the starting fee: the base fee in gwei, times the token price in USD, divided by 1,000.

gas.note: Enter USD per million gas at the starting fee: the base fee in gwei, times the token price in USD, divided by 1,000.

label: Blockchain indexer (unpriced)
description: Editable cost assumptions. No provider, machine size or deployment region has been selected.
priceNote: No rates supplied. The Graph bills queries in GRT, a token whose price moves, and hosted indexers price by plan. Enter your cost per million queries. An indexer you run yourself is a server and a database.

requests.note: Your cost per million queries: The Graph bills in GRT, whose price moves; hosted indexers price by plan.

label: Oracle (unpriced)
description: Editable cost assumptions. No provider, machine size or deployment region has been selected.
priceNote: No rates supplied. Public price feeds are paid for by their sponsors, so reading them costs you nothing. If you run your own updater, you pay this gas: enter your cost per million gas, worked out as for the contract.

gas.note: Reading a public feed costs you nothing. If you run the updater, enter USD per million gas as for the contract.

label: Decentralised storage (unpriced)
description: Editable cost assumptions. No provider, machine size or deployment region has been selected.
priceNote: No rates supplied. Pinning services (Pinata, Filebase, web3.storage) price per GB kept and per request by plan, and none publishes a machine-readable price list. Arweave charges once to store for good, in its own token. Enter your plan’s rates.

storage.note: Your pinning plan’s price per GB kept for a month.

requests.note: Your pinning plan’s price per million requests.
